title: Open a 512-robot training budget for the reward v4 arms
summary: The program lead opened a 512-robot training budget on 11 October after the throughput profiles placed the knee at 512 robots: 512 robots, 24 controls per robot and update, 2000 updates and the pilot deadline, with standing admission from the replicas input root. No run has started under the new budget, and a test covers the accepted and rejected counts.
